title: Harborline SiteGuard Cancellation Terms and Money-Back Guarantee
content:
**Terms.** Only the customer can cancel a Website Security plan, immediately or at term end, and a scheduled cancellation may be withdrawn before the term end date. An immediate cancellation of a 12-month plan is refunded in full only on or before the plan's opening date plus the tier's money-back days, in calendar days. The window adds whole calendar days to the opening date, counting the next day as day 1, and the last day is included. Where the tier excludes a plan with a used cleanup from the money-back guarantee, a plan that has had any expert cleanup (any expert manual cleanup recorded as included or paid over the whole life of the plan) gets no money-back refund, a 1-month charge is never refunded, and a cancellation before setup completes is refunded in full. Each charge is refunded only once.

## The ways a plan is cancelled

| Cancellation | Plan status before | Effect |
|---|---|---|
| Before setup completes | Pending setup | The plan is cancelled |
| Immediately | Active | The plan is cancelled at once |
| At term end | Active | The plan becomes cancel pending with auto-renew off and ends at the term end |
| Withdrawal of a scheduled cancellation, before the term end date | Cancel pending | The plan returns to active with auto-renew on |

## Evidence

The opening date, the plan's term, its cleanup history and its earlier refunds are taken from the company's records of the plan. A refund is recorded against the original charge it refunds, as a negative amount with its destination, the original payment method or account credit; a charge that already has a refund recorded against it is not refunded again.

## Money-back window boundary (hypothetical dates, money-back days 30)

| Opening date | Day 1 | Day 30, the last day | Immediate cancellation on day 30 | Immediate cancellation on the day after |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The 1st of a 31-day month | The 2nd | The 31st | Within the window | Outside the window |

## Points of judgement (hypothetical plans)

1. A 12-month plan with no expert cleanup on record is cancelled immediately 20 days after its opening date: it is refunded in full.
2. The same plan cancelled immediately 31 days after its opening date is outside the window and is not refunded under the guarantee.
3. A 12-month plan that had one included expert cleanup is cancelled immediately 10 days after its opening date: it gets no money-back refund.
4. An active plan on a 1-month term is cancelled immediately: its 1-month charge is not refunded.
